news.analysis: All has appeared in all six games for Cincinnati this season, playing 32% of the snaps and contributing for the Bengals in multi-tight end sets. He caught eight passes, returning from an injury that sidelined him in 2025. All has dealt with several injuries in his career, and the fear is this could be another season-ending ACL tear.

news.contents: The Cincinnati Bengals placed tight end Erick All Jr. (knee) on Injured Reserve on Tuesday with what is believed to be a torn ACL that he suffered in the Week 7 win over the division-rival Baltimore Ravens on Sunday, a source told Ian Rapoport of the NFL Network. In a corresponding move, the Bengals signed tight end Cam Grandy off the Minnesota Vikings' practice squad.
